patterns: re:No matching distribution found for llm-wiki(?!-plus)\b
entries.message: Install used the wrong PyPI name (llm-wiki). The published distribution is llm-wiki-plus.
entries.fix: Install with the interpreter that runs llmwiki: use llm-wiki-plus (or llm-wiki-plus[extra]), not llm-wiki.

entries.message: This interpreter has neither pip nor uv available, so doctor cannot install extras into it.
entries.fix: Install uv (https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) or enable pip for this Python, then re-run doctor and install the needed extra.

entries.message: llmwiki is running inside a uv-managed venv, but the uv binary is not on PATH.
entries.fix: Install uv and ensure it is on PATH, then use the printed uv pip install --python <this-python> command for extras.

entries.message: Optional [graph] extra is missing — graphify is not importable in this interpreter.
entries.fix: Install the graph extra into this interpreter (see install hint), then retry llmwiki graph.

entries.message: No usable vault or wiki/ directory is configured.
entries.fix: Pass --vault PATH to an existing vault with wiki/, or run llmwiki init --vault PATH, or set vault.default_path in config.json.

entries.message: No session adapters report an available store on this machine.
entries.fix: Run llmwiki adapters and llmwiki configure-sources; enable the agents you use and confirm their session paths exist.

entries.message: Optional [add] extra is missing — markitdown is not importable, so PDF/DOCX ingest will fail.
entries.fix: Install the add extra into this interpreter (see install hint), then retry llmwiki add.

entries.message: synthesis.backend is dummy (or unset) — real promote/synth work will not call an LLM.
entries.fix: Set synthesis.backend to ollama, claude, or cursor_cli in config.json and ensure that backend is available on PATH.

entries.message: Configured synthesis backend is set but not available in this environment.
entries.fix: Install/start the configured backend CLI (claude, ollama, or Cursor agent) or switch synthesis.backend to a working value.

entries.message: The synth queue still has unsynthesized raw sessions/docs waiting longer than the overdue threshold (from vault state synth.pending — not “any old file under raw/”).
entries.fix: Run llmwiki synth to drain the pending queue (then llmwiki build if the site should refresh). Already-synthesized raw files stay on disk forever and are not a backlog by themselves.

entries.message: Candidate stubs are awaiting review and may block the canonical loop.
entries.fix: Review with llmwiki candidates list / promote / merge / discard (or site candidates.html); apply --actions when ready. Doctor does not auto-run review decisions — they need a human.

entries.message: wiki/index.md (the page catalog) does not match pages on disk — a page exists that the catalog omits, or the catalog lists a missing path.
entries.fix: Run reindex to rewrite wiki/index.md from disk (safe). Consequence if skipped: Home/index navigation and counts miss those pages. Reindex does not delete, promote, or change candidate content — it only lists existing pages (including candidates/) in the catalog.

entries.message: Provenance chain from wiki page to raw source is broken or empty.
entries.fix: Inspect with llmwiki trace; repair via llmwiki migrate broken-provenance and/or llmwiki synth when appropriate.

entries.message: Vault shape looks like it needs a named llmwiki migrate repair.
entries.fix: List with llmwiki migrate --list; dry-run then apply the named migration. Doctor cannot pick the name for you — guided only until a detector attaches migrate:<name>.

entries.message: migrate session-tokens --adapter used a name that is not registered for Tokens origin backfill.
entries.fix: Use a registered token-capable adapter id (codex_cli, claude_code, or cursor_cli), e.g. llmwiki migrate session-tokens --vault <vault> --adapter codex_cli --skip-raw. Do not shorten to codex.

patterns: but no schedule for it is installed
entries.message: This vault records scheduled maintenance but the operating system holds no schedule for it.
entries.fix: Set up this vault's schedule again with llmwiki install-automation --vault <vault> (doctor shows the exact command and asks first).

entries.message: The installed schedule for this vault serves a different vault.
entries.fix: Set up this vault's own schedule with llmwiki install-automation --vault <vault>; schedules are per vault, so the other vault keeps its own.

patterns: runs from a checkout that no longer exists
entries.message: This vault's schedule runs from a checkout or wrapper script that no longer exists.
entries.fix: Set up this vault's schedule again from an installed llmwiki with llmwiki install-automation --vault <vault>.

patterns: could not check the installed schedule
entries.message: Doctor could not inspect the operating system scheduler, so this vault's schedule is unchecked.
entries.fix: Check the schedule by hand (systemctl --user list-timers, launchctl print gui/<uid>, or schtasks /Query) or run doctor where the scheduler is reachable.

patterns: existing schedule runs from a different checkout
entries.message: This vault already has a schedule that runs llmwiki from a different checkout, so install-automation stopped instead of replacing it.
entries.fix: Keep the existing schedule, or re-run llmwiki install-automation from the checkout you want the job to use and answer y (or pass --force) to replace it.

entries.message: The schedule was set up from a development copy of llmwiki and keeps running that copy.
entries.fix: Keep that copy in place, or set the schedule up again from a pip-installed llmwiki (pip install llm-wiki-plus, then llmwiki install-automation) so deleting or switching the checkout cannot break it.

entries.message: This vault's schedule is installed but has not completed a run recently.
entries.fix: Read the run log, then set this vault's schedule up again with llmwiki install-automation --vault <vault> (doctor shows the exact command and asks first).

entries.message: This vault's scheduled job ran but its last run exited with an error.
entries.fix: Read the run log doctor names and fix what the job reported (for example a missing synthesis backend or a broken source); the schedule itself does not need reinstalling. A usage-limit stop (exit 75) is not reported.

patterns: also scheduled by the earlier single
Could not switch off the earlier single llmwiki-maintain schedule
entries.message: The earlier single llmwiki-maintain schedule still runs for this vault beside the vault's own schedule.
entries.fix: Remove the old llmwiki-maintain schedule with the steps doctor (or install-automation) prints for this operating system; the vault's own schedule keeps running.

patterns: schedule for a vault that no longer exists
entries.message: A schedule llmwiki installed still runs for a vault folder that no longer exists.
entries.fix: Remove each leftover schedule with the steps doctor prints for this operating system; doctor does not remove it for you.

entries.message: Declared automation/scheduler units are not active.
entries.fix: Run llmwiki install-automation and activate the user units as documented (no sudo from doctor).

entries.message: site/ looks stale relative to wiki/ after pipeline work.
entries.fix: Run llmwiki build after synth or other wiki changes that should appear on the site.

entries.message: Agent kit or MCP consumer path looks outdated or mismatched.
entries.fix: Re-run llmwiki install-agent-kit --dest <agent-dir> and verify MCP flags match the current package.

entries.message: Doctor drafts must keep vault roots, usernames, and hostnames out of shared text.
entries.fix: Use placeholders (<vault>, <user>, <path>) in issue drafts and AI prompts; never paste personal vault roots.

unknown_templates.ai_prompt: Investigate this llmwiki doctor unknown symptom. Read {{agents_url}} and the heal catalog at {{kb_url}}. Symptom (paths redacted): {{symptom_redacted}}. Environment: version={{version}} os={{os}} interpreter={{interpreter_kind}} counts={{counts}}. Find root cause for this package version, propose a local fix, and draft a GitHub issue. Do not invent a shell command to run without evidence from the repo.
